text:
maria: Nightwatch handoff — quick summary and notes. What I did: mitigated an embed-ingest spike by scaling dedup workers (6 -> 18), rolled fallback to eu-west model variant for a few minutes. Blockers: PR #5118 blocked by flaky TestKVCacheEviction in CI. Today / next: monitor KV cache evictions, watch embed queue drain, follow runbook if 5xxs rise.

sam: thanks — what time did the spike start and how long did it last? any residual error rates?

maria: spike started ~02:14 UTC, ran ~9m. 5xxs peaked at ~0.7% on /v1/embeds, now back down to ~0.02%.

lee: are the embed workers still draining? any chance of backlog reappearing?

maria: draining now, ~12k items left. autoscaler will finish in ~15m. I increased workers to 18 manually to speed the drain.

anya: noted. I added a temporary alert tweak to suppress pages for <1% 5xx, still page if >2%. Should reduce noise while we stabilize.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @lee: deploy/insights-service v2.3.1 -> prod at 2026-03-17T02:50:12Z. status: in-progress

lee: that's my deploy, low-risk. rolling restarts will add ~100ms p95 for ~5m. monitoring on my side.

sam: CI note: rerunning PR #5123 — flake in TestKVCacheEviction. if that keeps failing, it will block other promos.

maria: blocker: PR #5118 can't be promoted because CI is red. prefer to fix the test rather than bypass, but leaving the option to cut a patch if AM needs it.

anya: @maria I can patch the flake with a short retry in the test, will open a PR and link here.

maria: :thumbsup: thanks. Runbook reminder if 5xx > 1% sustained: fallback model -> small-gpu variant. Command: `redwoodctl models rollback --id=insights-model --to=small-gpu` (runbook step 3).

lee: I'll watch the deploy and cluster metrics. ping me if queue starts growing again.

maria: Handoff complete. Handover checklist: kv-evictions: monitor dashboard (alerts enabled), embeds: monitor queue length and 5xx rate, incidents: none open. AM team, please confirm you see this and pick up monitoring. Good luck! :rocket:
